comment: Independent bones.c witness for restore.c find_lev_obj() on a loaded bones level. A debug human Valkyrie goes to a new level 3, is killed by a minotaur, and saves bones; drop_upon_death() leaves her possessions in a pile on her square. A second game on another seed and clock goes to level 3, loads the bones (bones.c getbones() -> restore.c getlev()), and quaffs a wished blessed potion of object detection, which maps the top object of every floor pile (detect.c object_detect()). find_lev_obj() rebuilds each pile from the saved floor chain with place_object(), so the head of that chain is on top. The seeds, clocks and inputs were chosen for this path.
